bundle.shortDescription: Standalone Retro Image, Video & Animation Dithering Suite
bundle.longDescription: DitherForge is a standalone desktop application for creating authentic retro-style dithering effects on images, video, and frame sequences using 84 public-domain and bespoke algorithms, 41 stackable post-effects, and multi-format vector/character grid exports.
